messages:
alex: heads up — noticed a spike of tenants with missing invoice lines for Mar 7-8. preview shows usage but final invoice has gaps.

maria: roughly how many tenants and what's the dollar delta?

alex: looks like ~48 tenants, ~12k USD net. digging but quick correlate shows a lot of `ingest-throttle` events around the same window.

jamal: that coincides with the last deploy where we introduced a 5s grace period in the ingest proxy to avoid dropped client retries. did we change any event wiring?

alex: yep, the proxy change adjusted the outbound envelope so the dedupe key (event_id) moved into `meta.trace.id` instead of `payload.event_id`. metering dedupe expects `payload.event_id`.

maria: oof. so throttled requests are acknowledged by proxy but downstream dedupe can't match and we end up dropping on dedupe-merge?

jamal: exact flow i see: client -> proxy (throttle + grace) -> router -> metering-ingest -> dedupe -> aggregator -> invoice. If the proxy ACKs and we later drop the queued in-flight after a retry, the write-ahead path didn't persist the right id so the event vanishes.

maya: can you paste the quick query you ran for the delta?

alex: sure:
```sql
-- count of missing finalized invoice events vs preview
select tenant_id, count(*) as missing_lines
from invoice_preview p
left join invoices i on p.tenant_id = i.tenant_id and p.preview_hash = i.final_hash
where i.id is null and p.created_at between '2025-03-07' and '2025-03-08'
group by tenant_id
order by missing_lines desc
limit 50;
```

data-ops-bot: logs (s3://metering-archive/2025/03/07/*.log) show repeated lines: `ingest-proxy: queued-event dropped after grace window, no ack persisted`

maria: two things: short term backfill from WAL/logs to reconstruct dedupe keys + patch the proxy to persist id into the envelope in the same field as before.

jamal: agree. for backfill we can rehydrate events from s3 raw logs and emit canonical `ingest-ack` to the metering topic. i'll own the backfill job.

alex: can you add a console flag/preview marker so customers see that these invoices were backfilled (so CS doesn't get surprised)? we should surface it in invoice preview as `backfilled: true` with a link to the reconciliation job.

maya: also add an alert rule: if preview vs finalized delta > 2% for 5m for any tenant, fire a `billing-recon` page. current alert only covers pipeline errors not delta.

jamal: plan: 1) start backfill job (jamal) 2) proxy quick patch and canary (maria + eng-runtime) 3) console preview marker (alex) 4) alert rule update (sre)

alex: quick ops commands to kick backfill (draft):
```bash
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP" https://ops-api.internal/jobs -d '{"job":"metering-backfill","s3_path":"s3://metering-archive/2025/03/07/","reconcile":true}'
```

maria: will schedule a 30% canary on edge region for the patch before global rollout. don't ship until jamal confirms backfill can catch up.

sre-bot: alert muted for `ingest-throttle-grace` during backfill window; will unmute on `backfill_complete` event.

alex: estimated customer impact window ~6-8 hours to backfill at current throughput. will update thread with progress. :eyes:

maya: assign owners in JIRA? i'll create MET-1289 (backfill + console flag) and MET-1290 (proxy envelope rollback) and tag the accountable eng leads.

alex: thanks everyone. main risks: partial replay duplicates (we need idempotency), and UX confusion — alex will add preview banner and a short FAQ snippet for CS.

maria: also add a short regression test to CI that checks `event_id` field stays in `payload.event_id`. i'll PR in 10m. :+1:

jamal: starting backfill run now (ETA first batch 45m). will post progress updates.

alex: awesome — keep posting logs. if we see unexpected duplicates we'll pause and consult. :thumbsup:
